title.narrative: Towards a Green Economy in Uruguay: Stimulating Sustainable Production Practices and Low-Emission Technologies in Prioritized Sectors

description.narrative: The aim of the project is to transform the different kinds of waste generated in the agriculture and the agro-industry production chains in Uruguay into various types of energy and/or other byproducts with the aim of reducing greenhouse gas emissions (GHG), while contributing to the development of a low carbon sustainable production model supported by an adequate technology development and transfer. This project is requested by the Government of Uruguay to UNIDO through the GEF operational focal point at the Ministry of Housing,Territorial Planning and Environment (MVOTMA) of Uruguay as part of the government of Uruguay's efforts to mitigate climate change.
